MMM.rationale: MMM presents a deeply unattractive fundamental picture. Q1 2026 results show severe earnings deterioration: EPS of $1.23 is down 39.7% YoY and 20.6% QoQ, with net income falling 41.3% YoY. Operating cash flow collapsed 826.6% YoY to just $574M. The balance sheet is strained with total equity of only $3.31B against $32.12B in liabilities, implying a P/B of 28.3x — an extreme multiple for a company with declining earnings. The PE has expanded from ~18.7x a year ago to 33.5x today despite earnings falling sharply, meaning the market is paying nearly double for materially worse earnings power. Net margin has compressed from 17.9% to 11.2%. The company faces massive ongoing PFAS litigation liabilities (including a new May 2026 Minnesota lawsuit seeking $30K/violation/day), a $10.3B settlement already committed, and continued restructuring charges. The Q2 2026 earnings beat and Microsoft AI partnership are positive but do not fundamentally alter the trajectory — the stock rallied 6.3% on that news, already pricing in the beat. With 10Y yields at 4.68 and rising, the 33.5x PE on declining earnings with significant legal overhang is extremely stretched. The stock has run +22.4% in one quarter on deteriorating fundamentals, creating a dangerous disconnect.
